nodes.label: Logo-B (Native App Brand Asset)
nodes.description: Avantej brand logo variant B for the React Native / Expo mobile app. The mark is a stylized fingerprint rendered in solid black on a white/transparent background. Concentric oval ridges spiral inward, terminating in a central letterform that reads as a combined 'A' or abstract 'C/O' — consistent with 'Avantej' initial identity. The fingerprint motif evokes identity, uniqueness, and biometric/security themes appropriate for a multi-tenant SaaS platform managing member access and permissions. Monochrome palette (pure black strokes, white fill) makes it suitable for both light-mode UI and dark-background overlays. The design is icon-grade: no wordmark is included, making it suitable as an app icon, splash-screen mark, or tab-bar logo.

nodes.label: Avantej Fingerprint Logo Motif
nodes.description: The shared visual motif across Avantej logo variants: concentric oval ridges forming a stylized fingerprint shape. Signals identity management, tenant uniqueness, and access control — directly aligned with the platform's multi-tenant SaaS architecture and RBAC model.

nodes.label: Native Expo App (apps/native)
nodes.description: The React Native / Expo mobile application for Avantej. Member-facing (not admin). Uses Expo Router with (auth)/, (app)/, and (drawer)/ route groups. Shares oRPC client and Better-Auth client with the web app but has separate entry points and route files.
